description: This file defines the PlaywrightConnection class responsible for managing WebSocket communication, connection lifecycle, and dispatching in the Playwright testing framework. It handles message passing, connection setup, disconnection cleanup, and integrates with various Playwright components.

classes.name: PlaywrightConnection
classes.description: Manages WebSocket communication, connection lifecycle, and dispatching for Playwright, including handling messages, disconnections, and cleanup.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and resource release when the connection is disconnected.

methods.name: logServerMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata about messages sent and received over the WebSocket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection, optionally with a reason.
